heading: DEFINITIONS.
text: In this Act, unless otherwise specified:

heading: AMENDMENTS TO SUBTITLE III OF TITLE 40.
ACTIONS TO ENHANCE FEDERAL INCIDENT RE- SPONSE.
ADDITIONAL GUIDANCE TO AGENCIES ON FISMA UPDATES.
text: Not later than 1 year after the date of enactment of this Act, the Director, in coordination with the Director of the Cybersecurity and Infrastructure Security Agency, shall issue guidance for agencies on—

heading: AGENCY REQUIREMENTS TO NOTIFY ENTITIES IMPACTED BY INCIDENTS.
text: Not later than 180 days after the date of enactment of this Act, the Director shall issue guidance that requires agencies to notify entities that are compelled to share sensitive information with the agency of an incident that impacts—

heading: DATA AND LOGGING RETENTION FOR INCIDENT RESPONSE.
IMPLEMENTING PRESUMPTION OF COMPROMISE AND ZERO TRUST ARCHITECTURES.
EXTENSION OF FEDERAL ACQUISITION SECURITY COUNCIL.
text: Section 1328 of title 41, United States Code, is amended by striking ‘‘the date’’ and all that follows and inserting ‘‘December 31, 2026.’’. ENHANCE FEDERAL CYBERSECURITY
